goal: Every 3 hours the fable auditor looks over all of sw factory and tells the owner in its DM what is a problem, worth reporting, a suggestion or unusual, and says nothing when nothing stands out. The precheck (apps/chat/scripts/duties/fable-sweep.ts) reads :5184 across every agent that is not a test or archived: owner posts of the last 3 h that no agent answered after 10 min, owner posts whose delivery failed, stayed queued or reached no agent, jobs that read working with no new entry for 45 min (rule 6) and jobs that failed in the last 24 h, failed work and comm threads, duties whose last run missed or errored, and open board steps with no live job, running wait or open owner todo. Job entry times come from the pi-host thread files, read only. Each item carries its :5184 link and is raised once, then again a day later while it stays, so a quiet run starts no job and costs no Fable turn. Its first run on 11-22 took 0.4 s and found 10 items: 2 owner posts with no answer, 1 stuck job, 5 duties off target and 2 steps nobody moves.

metrics.label: Items new since the last sweep, or last raised a day ago: owner posts with no answer, delivery errors, stuck or failed jobs, duties off target and steps nobody moves

onMiss: This duty asks for a report, not fixes, so these lines replace the brief's lines on fix steps, subagents and the 3-line report. Read the flagged lines above and, only as you need it, the detail file they name, which lists every item with its :5184 link; open a linked thread, board or duty only to tell a real problem from noise. Start no job or subagent, add no fix step, change no board and edit no file. Pick what is a real problem, a thing to report, a suggestion or something unusual, and drop what is fine, such as a step whose job reported a minute ago. Send one message for the owner's DM with send_message, or as your final answer, in Slack style per the sw-factory skill: the answer first in one plain line, then one `- ` bullet per item with its link and the agent that should take it, at most 120 words, with no headings, labels or tables. When nothing stands out, reply exactly "nothing to report".
